question: Does a lower confidence cut for the ball (before and in the link) recover the shooter's ball near the goals without picking false balls? (owner, 2026-10-27)
status: exploratory, CPU, written before any relink

variants.zone03: 0.10 elsewhere, 0.03 for candidates whose ground point is within 16.5 m of a goal line (their confidence rescaled so that 0.03 there acts as 0.10)

pipeline otherwise: as now: no grass test, players' frames, top 4, outline, ball_link.link (c_null 1, c_static 2)

stage 1 (all variants).verified balls: 4 windows (M6 2nd f015000 / f037500, M7 1st f030000, M9 2nd f030000): on 'ball' frames, linked ball within 12 px (hit) and linked ball elsewhere (wrong pick)
stage 1 (all variants).shots: ball_goal measure 2 (linked ball at the shooter's feet within +-0.4 s), near a goal and elsewhere, all shots clips but M1

choice: the variant with the highest share of shots near a goal with the linked ball at the feet, among those whose wrong-pick rate on verified balls is at most the current one + 0.02; none if no variant beats t10 by 5 points
stage 2 (the chosen variant only): the v3 shot spotter's nested leave-one-match-out on the same units (shots_learn/v3), against its no-grass result (150 hits, 126 false, 119 missed); and rule C (who made the action) on the seen matches and M7 / M9 against ball_grass/score.json
adopt if: stage 2: shot hits up and rule C not down by more than 1 point on either set
